summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py per the guide; the other modules now call it and keep their public functions. The existing tests and the new tests/test_timeparse.py pass under UTC and America/New_York. I did not keep a copy of the original package, so I did not run a side-by-side comparison of CLI output. Behaviours kept on purpose: two-digit and negative years in DMY, 24:00, sources that differ on missing offsets, and 'inf' or huge epoch values and years crashing with OverflowError/OSError as before. The new module raises a ValueError subclass for those, and the old modules re-raise the original error.
